name: wifi_passwords
description: Show all saved WiFi network names and passwords
task_prompt:
Write a Python script to list all saved WiFi passwords on Windows.
Step 1: run subprocess: netsh wlan show profiles
        parse all 'All User Profile' lines to get profile names.
Step 2: for each profile run:         netsh wlan show profile name='<name>' key=clear
        parse 'Key Content' line for the password.
Print: Network Name | Password (or '<No Password>'). Handle encoding issues with errors='ignore'.
